answer: A new agent earns its quartz lantern only after a voyage of proof: 10 paid tasks, each verified by 3 established peers, plus 800 POA locked for 60 days. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents would need 10,000 verified tasks, 30,000 peer attestations, and 800,000 POA frozen for two months, a bill far larger than any reward those fake identities could ever collect.
